title: Enabling Classifiers to Make Judgements Explicitly Aligned with Human Values
reasoning: The paper focuses on aligning model judgments with human values, ethics, and moral norms. It uses a sexism classification task that includes specific categories related to faith and ethics, such as 'Religion-based sexism' (prejudice stemming from religious scriptures) and 'Moral policing', and it references literature on moral philosophy to define these values.
